title: TinyTable DHT RPC Object v0.1
description: Network-layer discovery RPC. Sibling of the room-event envelope in federation v0.1, NOT a room event: it carries no room_id or author_id and confers no authority. Routing only. Signed and verified with the same Ed25519 path as room events.

rpc_id.description: Idempotency / replay key, same role as event_id for room events.

origin_host_id.description: Friendly host label; must match a known federation_hosts row for the signature check.

origin_node_id.description: Routing coordinate = SHA256(origin host public_key), hex. Self-certifying: the receiver recomputes it from the pubkey it already verifies and rejects a mismatch.

signature.description: base64url Ed25519 signature over the canonical object without this field, exactly as federation.sign_event does.

public_key.description: base64url raw Ed25519 public key; SHA256 of its raw bytes must equal node_id.

target.description: The key being looked up: a node_id, or SHA256("room:"+room_id) / SHA256("commons:"+record_id) for keyspace lookups.

nodes.description: Up to k contacts closest to target by XOR distance, from the responder's routing table.
